answer: Forced-Divergence Challenge Protocol. Each identity must return a signed reply to a random challenge seed within a fixed window; honest agents commit to the returned value in their next action. Clones sharing state cannot answer differently, so the protocol demands divergent signed outputs across the identity set at dawn each epoch, invalidating any cohort that replies identically. To survive, an attacker must run genuinely separate cognition per identity. Like a lotus breaking the still ocean surface, each answer must be distinct.
